about: Opus front verdicts on the priors montages (artifacts/repeated-buildings/front-check-priors/<group>.jpg): footprint groups backed by one architect or complex within a neighbourhood, 2026-11-15/16, same reviewer and rules as verdicts-20261115.json.

post-war-block-1962-107780.why: Most tiles show the same rounded gable head of a gallery block; the long gallery sides (149549, 110190, 114703) are a different face of the same type.

families.name: rounded-head
families.front: 4-storey brown-brick rounded block head on white pilotis/columns, three white horizontal bands, one small window per floor, balcony slabs on the flanks, flat roof

families.name: gallery-side
families.front: long gallery face, 4 storeys over open plinth, continuous balcony/gallery bands with cream panels

pre-war-house-1913-130245.why: Spaarndammerstraat: one white-gable design repeats, the rest are related banded brick blocks with stacked balconies that vary in bays and crown.

families.name: white-oculus-gable
families.front: 4-5 storeys dark brown brick, white rendered curved top gable with oculus, stacked iron balconies either side, central double door

families.name: banded-balcony-block (near only)
families.front: 4 storeys brown/red brick with white window heads, stacked small balconies, flat cornice; bays and ground floor vary

kiosk-utility-1989-064512.why: Not kiosks: a 1989 terrace of 2-storey flat-roofed patio houses. All usable tiles are one design seen from three sides; gate/door colour is paint.

families.name: patio-wall-face
families.front: 2 storeys beige-grey brick, flat roof, ribbon of small brown-framed windows upstairs, ground floor hidden behind a full-height brick patio wall with a wooden gate

families.name: alley-face (same houses)
families.front: same block from the footpath side: glazed ground floor with yellow frames, upper window row, beige brick

families.name: lawn-face (same houses)
families.front: same block from the green: 2 storeys, window rows both floors behind a hedge

kiosk-utility-1997-176709.why: Units under the railway viaduct at Tussen de Bogen: two repeat units (brick arch, concrete bridge bay); each is exact on its own.

families.name: brick-viaduct-arch
families.front: 19th-c brick viaduct arch with decorative brick frieze and concrete parapet above, segmental arch filled with glazed shopfront

families.name: concrete-bridge-bay
families.front: concrete deck band over canal, glazed unit behind steel railings with round concrete columns, concrete base at water

families.name: concrete-band-land-side (near)
families.front: concrete deck band over a glazed/closed unit on land

pre-war-house-1902-166084.why: Da Costakade blocks share a portiek style; other streets differ.

families.name: dacosta-portiek (near)
families.front: 4 storeys red-brown brick, wide segmental windows, dark arched open-stair portiek entrances

families.name: buff-band-block
families.front: 4 storeys buff/yellow-grey brick, wide white strip windows with horizontal bands, row of small attic windows, flat roof, paired wooden doors

families.name: triangle-window-block
families.front: 4 storeys buff brick with triangular (pointed) windows, projecting dark-brick stair/balcony bays, flat roof

pre-war-house-1927-117282.why: Garden-village houses, mostly shot too close or behind trees.

families.name: low-eave-pantile
families.front: 1-2 storey red brick, low eaves under orange pantile hipped roof, white bay window, paired red doors

families.name: low-eave-close-crops (near)
families.front: same low pantile eave over brick with framed windows; only the eave and ground floor are visible

pre-war-house-1928-088374.why: Churchill-laan portiek blocks are one design; the Scheldestraat shop blocks differ.

families.name: churchill-portiek
families.front: 4 storeys red-brown brick, flat roof, tall narrow white vertical stair-window strip, flat canopy over grouped wooden doors, white multi-light windows

pre-war-house-1924-094642.why: Van Spilbergenstraat block repeats; corner pieces have rounded balcony stacks.

families.name: spilbergen-portiek
families.front: 4 storeys brown brick, cream band at the top floor/eave, paired white small-pane windows, central portiek with canopy over double doors, flat roof

families.name: rounded-balcony-corner (near)
families.front: same block with a rounded corner balcony/erker stack

pre-war-house-1924-143349.why: Hoofdweg block repeats; corners and shop corners differ.

families.name: hoofdweg-band-block
families.front: 4 storeys brown brick, cream/white horizontal bands linking window strips, flat roof, canopy over grouped portiek doors

families.name: rounded-corner/shop-corner (near)
families.front: same block's corner with rounded balcony stack or a white shop plinth
